verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that https://docs.trychroma.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and indexes the docs as per-page .md links, which an agent can follow directly. The getting-started guide also ships agent-oriented setup prompts meant to be pasted into Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. A machine-readable openapi.json further supports agent consumption. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually use the llms.txt or prompts effectively.
